mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hashtags (tag_name, created_at) VALUES (#{tagName}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT h.hashtag_id, h.tag_name, h.created_at FROM hashtags h WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_hashtags ph WHERE ph.hashtag_id = h.hashtag_id ) ORDER BY h.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT h.hashtag_id, h.tag_name, h.created_at FROM hashtags h INNER JOIN post_hashtags ph ON h.hashtag_id = ph.hashtag_id WHERE ph.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY h.tag_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hashtags h WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_hashtags ph WHERE ph.hashtag_id = h.hashtag_id )
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hashtags WHERE tag_name = #{tagName})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_hashtags (post_id, hashtag_id, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{hashtagId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_hashtags WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND hashtag_id = #{hashtagId}
mapper.select: SELECT h.hashtag_id as hashtagId, h.tag_name as tagName, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.post_id) as postCount, COALESCE(SUM(comment_stats.comment_count), 0) as commentCount, ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT ph.post_id) * 0.7 + COALESCE(SUM(comment_stats.comment_count), 0) * 0.3, 2 ) as heatScore FROM hashtags h INNER JOIN post_hashtags ph ON h.hashtag_id = ph.hashtag_id INNER JOIN posts p ON ph.post_id = p.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) as comment_count FROM comments WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY post_id ) comment_stats ON p.post_id = comment_stats.post_id WHERE p.created_at BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY h.hashtag_id, h.tag_name ORDER BY heatScore DESC LIMIT #{limit}
